name: Civic Portal
tagline: An accessibility-first template for a city, agency, or public institution.
description: An accessibility-first portal for a city or public agency — a clear welcome band, a task-first services directory, a state-aware public-notices and alerts channel, a live news feed, and a light civic shop, in a white-ground deep-federal-blue theme tuned for AAA contrast. Modelled on the government/public-service archetype; shipped as the City of Rivermark. Ships a light shop (a city publication, two passes) to demonstrate content + commerce together.
